name: carochat
description: An online instant messaging service similar to FBC # Carochat An online instant messaging service similar to FBC This is an instant messaging service where you can send messages, images, change your profile picture through dragging edit your profile settings. You can log in/log out. Also sign up and after that process be redirected to the login page in order to start your chat. Images can be clicked on and zoomed in on too. I also used MYSQL for the user database.
